description: This file implements a driver for Nuvoton Numaker SPI hardware in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, data transfer, initialization, and hardware control functions.

methods.name: spi_numaker_configure
methods.description: Configures the SPI hardware with specified settings such as mode, word size, and frequency.

methods.name: spi_numaker_txrx
methods.description: Performs a single SPI transmit/receive operation based on the current context.

methods.name: spi_numaker_remain_words
methods.description: Checks if there are remaining words to transmit or receive in the current SPI context.

methods.name: spi_numaker_transceive
methods.description: Handles full transceive operation, including locking, configuration, and data transfer.

methods.name: spi_numaker_release
methods.description: Releases the SPI device, unlocking the context.

methods.name: spi_numaker_init
methods.description: Initializes the SPI device, including clock, pinctrl, reset, and context setup.
